title: Stable phone panning and dialog scrolling
summary: Corrected conflicting touch and scroll behavior in the realistic viewer and prevented automatic scroll jumps.

changes.detail: Allow native horizontal and vertical touch panning of the enlarged image; permit scroll chaining at image edges and remove the nested scroll container in full-phone view.
Use stable viewport height for zoom and stop resize events recentering the image while browsing. Component picker no longer jumps the outer page to the explanation.
Lock background scrolling while detail dialog is open and restore focus without scrolling when it closes.
Passive pointer tracking suppresses clicks after dragging or gesture cancellation; scroll handling stays passive and clears double-tap tracking.

validation.name: Focused checks
validation.detail: Pending regression, typecheck, lint and history checks. Device scroll/performance measurements and live visual verification not yet performed. No deployment.
